summary: Sony Group Corp filed a Form 6-K furnishing a translation of its monthly Share Buyback Report for April 2026. The filing details two board-authorized open-market repurchase programs: the first (May 14, 2025 resolution) authorized up to 100 million shares / ¥250 billion, which concluded on October 27, 2025; the second (February 26, 2026 resolution, expanded from November 2025) authorized up to 90 million shares / ¥250 billion, which concluded on March 24, 2026. Both programs were executed via discretionary trading contracts on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. No specific price per share or premium is stated. This is a routine periodic update of completed buybacks, not a new authorization or tender offer.
